 :       : This brings up the new overlay-type puzzle, using the 
 :       : puzzle nicknamed "ICExit".
@>Comment: There are effectively four solution states. The 
 :       : following components are "powered":
 :       : State 1 (initial): Gates
 :       : State 2: Gates, Jigsaw
 :       : State 3: Ground Signal
 :       : State 4 (ideal): Jigsaw, Ground Signal
@>Comment: If the player finds the ideal solution, the solution 
 :       : "locks in"; interacting again shows the solution, but 
 :       : does not allow them to change it.
 :       : If the player does not provide the ideal solution, they 
 :       : should be able to interact with this puzzle again to 
 :       : attempt to improve their solution.
@>Script: circuitIntegrationChamberExit(68,48,45,14)
